ext_desc.message: Zhejiang University RVPN support: the local rvpn-core binary provides the aTrust / EasyConnect tunnel, the extension provides the UI and the browser proxy.

hint_mode_normal.message: Normal mode: no VPN, any proxy override set by the extension is cleared.

hint_mode_rvpn.message: RVPN mode: rvpn-core connects to the campus VPN and the browser proxy points at the core SOCKS5 port.

hint_mode_persist.message: The mode is remembered and restored after a browser restart. If RVPN cannot be established the extension falls back to normal mode and tells you why.

label_proxy_all.message: Route all traffic through the VPN (proxyAll)

options_subtitle.message: The VPN tunnel is provided by the local rvpn-core binary; the extension provides the UI and the browser proxy.

hint_user_type.message: ZJU users get the built-in servers and routing rules; non-ZJU users must fill in server, port, login domain and auth type themselves.

hint_server.message: Leave empty to use the built-in address for the selected user type (ZJU: vpn.zju.edu.cn / rvpn.zju.edu.cn).

hint_protocol_atrust_zju.message: aTrust (L3) is the ZJU default: the server is filled in as vpn.zju.edu.cn and the login domain is fixed to Radius.

hint_protocol_easyconnect_zju.message: EasyConnect (L2, advanced): legacy client compatibility, the server is filled in as rvpn.zju.edu.cn.

hint_protocol_atrust.message: aTrust (L3) is the default protocol for non-ZJU servers; use "Probe auth methods" to discover the login domain and auth type.

hint_protocol_easyconnect.message: EasyConnect (L2, advanced): some servers only support this protocol.

hint_login_domain_zju.message: The login domain is fixed to Radius for Zhejiang University users.

hint_login_domain_other.message: Non-ZJU users should enter the login domain advertised by the server, or use "Probe auth methods".

warn_password_plain.message: The password is stored in plain text in local browser storage (chrome.storage.local), readable only on this machine. If "Save password" is unchecked it is kept in background memory only and must be re-entered after a browser restart.

hint_password_plain.message: Note: the password is stored in plain text in local browser storage. Judge the risk yourself.

hint_password_not_saved.message: Password saving is off; the password is only valid for this session.

hint_options_more.message: Login domain, auth type, TOTP and ports are configured on the "Login settings" page.

hint_phone.message: Required when the auth type is "SMS code" (include the country code, e.g. 8613800138000).

hint_phone_zju.message: Optional: fill this in if your campus account uses SMS second-factor verification (include the country code).

hint_totp.message: Optional; used to answer TOTP / second-factor challenges automatically. Leave empty to type codes by hand.

hint_port_auto.message: Empty = pick a free port automatically (core default 127.0.0.1:0). Proxies only listen on loopback.

hint_proxy_all.message: By default only traffic matching ZJU resources and rules goes through RVPN; everything else is direct.

hint_probe.message: The probe calls the core `authInfo` command and lists the login domains / auth types offered by the server; click one to fill it in.

hint_other_auto.message: For non-ZJU users disableZJUConfig and skipDomainResource are applied automatically (server-provided resource rules only).

alert_core_missing_body.message: The extension cannot reach the native host $1. Make sure rvpn-core and its native messaging manifest are installed, then retry. Error: $2

alert_fallback_title.message: The last RVPN connection failed, normal mode was restored

suspend_core_down.message: The connection to rvpn-core dropped and the browser proxy was cleared ($1). Reconnecting automatically.

suspend_no_socks.message: rvpn-core has not exposed a SOCKS5 port yet, the browser proxy is not active.

suspend_proxy_failed.message: Could not set the browser proxy: $1

challenge_no_login_url.message: The core did not provide a login URL; log in with your browser and paste the callback address.

challenge_image_failed.message: Could not load the captcha image

probe_empty.message: The server returned no auth methods; please fill in the login domain and auth type manually.

probe_result_hint.message: Click one of the entries below to fill in the login domain and auth type.

diag_copy_failed.message: Copy failed, please select the text manually

err_host_not_found.message: Native host com.achtrw.rvpn not found (native messaging manifest missing or wrong path)

err_disconnected.message: The connection to rvpn-core was closed

err_bad_port.message: The port must be an integer between 1 and 65535

err_phone_required.message: SMS authentication requires a phone number

err_bad_socks_addr.message: The core returned an invalid SOCKS address: $1

log_restore_ok.message: RVPN connection restored automatically from the saved mode

log_proxy_failed.message: Could not set the browser proxy: $1

log_fallback.message: RVPN could not start, fell back to normal mode: $1

log_settings_restart.message: Connection settings changed, restarting the core
